caption:
Today I had a meeting with Ms Abigail Thulare (CEO) Robben Island and Freedom Park Council, Prof. Saths Cooper, to find common ground for the major stakeholders of Robben Island. The intention is to revive this historical site and make it a major tourist, historical and educational site.

The intention is also to revive the island into a historical site that should constantly remind us that never again shall this beautiful land experience the pain of injustice.

#WeDoTourism
